blocks.title: Spam
blocks.text: Spam is unwanted messages received by email or phone.
Text messages from unknown numbers may offer products, fake prizes or cheap loans you never asked for. They waste time and may try to trick you into giving personal information or money.

blocks.prompt: Why should you never reply to an SMS offering a prize you did not enter?
blocks.explanation: It is likely spam or a scam trying to get your personal details or money; replying also confirms your number is active.

items: Spam: unwanted messages (fake prizes, loans) that waste time and may be scams.
